title.en: Reading HBT8018 Concrete Pump with the section names of Engine balance
title.zh: 用来源页《发动机平衡》的章节名来读HBT8018混凝土泵

description.en: Engine balance provides the section names for HBT8018 Concrete Pump. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai publishes HBT8018 Concrete Pump. The published table prints Motor Power 132 kW; Theoretical Output 60 m³/h; Pumping Pressure 40 MPa; Conveying Distance 150 m; Delivery Height 450 m; Max. Aggregate Size 4 cm and below; Delivery Pipe Diameter 100 / 125 mm; Dimensions (L×W×H) 6700 × 1750 × 1800 mm; Total Weight 6500 kg. Not printed, so left blank: cylinder bore, piston stroke, service life, a material grade number. The content photograph does not add a figure that the table omits.
description.zh: 《发动机平衡》为HBT8018混凝土泵提供章节名。邢台河北品锦机械公布HBT8018混凝土泵。已公布参数表印有：电机功率132 kW；理论输送量60 m³/h；泵送压力40 MPa；输送距离150 m；输送高度450 m；最大骨料粒径4 cm and below；输送管内径100 / 125 mm；外形尺寸6700 × 1750 × 1800 mm；整机重量6500 kg。没有印出、因此留空的栏目：缸径、活塞行程、使用寿命、材料牌号。内容照片不会补上参数表没有的数字。
